shape.description: multivalent_source: one delimited column holds all selected codes (e.g. '2 5 9'), with sibling binary dummy columns that must NOT be separately ingested. single_value: one column, one value per respondent. numeric_score: one column, a 0-10 or 1-7 numeric rating. multi_select_dummies: a 'select all that apply' question with NO delimited base column at all -- the raw file only has independent one-hot dummy columns (e.g. q67_1..q67_13, each 0/1); source_column is a nominal/representative stem name only, the real data to read lives in dummy_columns, and delimiter does not apply.

source_column.description: The ONE real data-file column to read for this question. For shape=multivalent_source this is the delimited column, never a dummy column.

delimiter.description: Required when shape=multivalent_source, e.g. ' ' or ','. Null otherwise.

dummy_columns.description: Informational only when shape=multivalent_source: the sibling one-hot columns that exist in the raw file but must be ignored by the loader in favor of source_column. Empty for single_value/numeric_score.

code_to_label.description: Maps each raw code value (as it appears in source_column, e.g. '2') to its real-world label (e.g. 'Amul'). Required whenever bucket implies brand/attribute identity (TOM/SPONT/AIDED/EVER_USED/CURRENT_USER/CONSIDERATION/PREFERRED/BRAND_IMAGERY/PORTFOLIO_AWARENESS).

reasoning.description: One sentence: why this bucket/shape/source_column, referencing what was observed in the AP, datamap, or raw sample.
